catalog.scope: CMR reports geographic/temporal relevance only; approximate footprints do not establish native-grid intersection or useful river WSE. No archive object or credentials read. Source inspection and explicit native indices required; per-page Search-After queries are not an atomic catalog snapshot.

admission.execution: serial synchronous delivery; no next decoder while writer retains a tile
admission.source_scope: source budget includes decoder, encoded-range retention, prepared metadata/coordinates, authentication and checkpoint index/write scratch
admission.scope: working reservations; excludes allocator, TLS/HTTP runtime, OS/filesystem cache and caller-owned inputs; process RSS measured separately

authenticated_scope.credential_forwarding: login origin only; none to archive or signed resource
authenticated_scope.cookies: memory only; exact origin jars; none to signed resource
authenticated_scope.conditional_reads: strong ETag, If-Match, exact Content-Range and Content-Length, identity encoding
authenticated_scope.signed_routes: GET only, advertised expiry minus 30 seconds, at most 60 seconds; HEAD always canonical
